Name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
Description: Owner: Marcus. Fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback that occurs when a user backgrounds the app mid-photo-upload on Android 14. Repro: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. Currently ~4% of Android sessions, top crasher. Deadline: fixed and verified by Wednesday (Aug 12) so QA has time before the Aug 20 release.

Name: QA verify Android 14 crash fix on test devices
Description: Owner: Sam. Once Marcus lands the Android 14 photo upload crash fix, confirm it on the Android 14 test devices and add it to the regression run. Must be completed before the Aug 20 mobile release.

Name: Build offline sync API for notes list
Description: Owner: Elena. Build the backend sync API endpoint this sprint: client sends last-synced timestamp and gets a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins; no merge UI this pass. Have the sync API in review before Elena is out on the 17th-18th.

Name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
Description: Owner: Marcus. Implement client side of offline notes: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay them when connectivity returns. Write the acceptance criteria into the ticket: open app in airplane mode, see notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when back online with no data loss. Promised to enterprise customers last quarter.

Name: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
Description: Owner: Sam. Finish the test and release pipelines on GitHub Actions (build job POC already exists), keep the nightly build schedule, and run both GitHub Actions and Jenkins in parallel for a week before turning Jenkins off. Keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean. Approved by Priya.

Name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
Description: Owner: Elena. Add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint after last week's incident where a misbehaving script degraded search for everyone. Requirements: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that, and add a metrics counter so we can see who's hitting the limit.

Name: Update GDPR consent screen for EU launch
Description: Owner: Marcus. Update the privacy policy/consent screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, nothing pre-checked (no single pre-checked box). Get new copy from legal, rebuild the screen. Must be in the Aug 20 release; it is a launch blocker.

Name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
Description: Owner: Sam. Write regression tests for the payments flow covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal: have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline. Payments flow currently has no automated coverage and caused issues in the last release.
